'''LS-261''' was the [[Operating number|designation]] of a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[stormtrooper]] who was stationed in the [[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Imperial Complex]] on [[Lothal]] during the [[Imperial Era|era]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He and another stormtrooper were left to guard a drugged [[Hera Syndulla]] after she had been interrogated by [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]]. They were [[Rescue of Hera Syndulla (Lothal)|confronted]] by Syndulla's [[Jedi]] ally, [[Kanan Jarrus]], who used his [[Force power]]s to throw both [[trooper]]s out of a window.

==Biography==
Following [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]]'s failed [[Attack on Lothal|attempt]] to destroy the [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter]] [[Imperial Armory Complex|factory]], LS-261 and another stormtrooper were tasked with guarding [[Hera Syndulla]] while [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] interrogated the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] leader. Believing that Hera was delirious, Pryce left the room to talk with the [[Noghri]] tracker [[Rukh]]. LS-261 and his comrade faced Hera, who told them they were in "terrible trouble" and warned them that [[Kanan Jarrus]] was going to enter [[Pryce's office]].<ref name="Jedi Night" />

Kanan then used his [[Kanan Jarrus' lightsaber|lightsaber]] to cut a hole around LS-261's companion, causing him to fall to his [[death]]. LS-261 then radioed on his [[comlink]] that there were under attack, but Kanan used [[the Force]] to hurl him out the window, throwing him to his death. Kanan and Hera then [[Rescue of Hera Syndulla (Lothal)|escaped]] the building, however, they were pursued by Rukh and Governor Pryce's forces.<ref name="Jedi Night" />

==Personality and traits==
LS-261 was the designation of a male human<ref name="ECUC" /> stormtrooper stationed at the Imperial Complex on Lothal. He wore white armor over a black uniform.<ref name="Jedi Night" />

==Behind the scenes==
LS-261 first appeared in the "[[Jedi Night]]," the tenth episode of the [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]] of ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'', where he was voiced by [[Stephen Stanton]] and credited as "Stormtrooper #3".
